tracks.title: Hollow Show
tracks.lyrics:
When I was young
My mama told me

To confess all my sins, to the man called a priest
The church was full of people, both old and young
People who I've seen doing drugs and drinking rum
The priest also told us that the salt can't lose its saltiness
That we must remain pure, repenting and sacramenting
Rinse and repeat

Then I grew up
And saw for myself
That the priest isn't holy
That the church isn't saintly
That it's all Hollow Show
Then I realized
That the Devil ain't so bad
That all he wanted was for us to have what he had
To live, to die, to love, to enjoy
To know, to create, to become our own gods

tracks.title: Commandments
tracks.lyrics:
We’re told to obey

story: This is my second official album. Where the first kept to a single palette, these songs move across genres — country, urban and pop, opera, glitch-hop, even bluegrass.

The lyrics reach toward religious and spiritual deconstruction, and restitution — questions, inquiries, and thoughts that have permeated my mind throughout my life; a representation of the burden of imposed beliefs. Its conclusion is open-ended on purpose, because my art is still a work in progress, and so are my beliefs…

story: “Nos Creemos Algo” is FaXto’s first Spanish-language release on streaming platforms. Blending hyperpop and reggaetón, the song plays with the idea that we convince ourselves we are something while, in the cosmic sense, being nothing. It reduces us back to something more basic — animals making noise — while still insisting on the peculiar human habit of gathering the pieces, improvising rituals, and moving forward through life’s adversities.
